title: Build AI-powered soccer insights apps with AKS and ACA
description:
Learn how to build and deploy AI-powered applications that analyze football match and player data using AKS and ACA. 

Using Premier League-inspired scenarios such as identifying team play styles, analyzing counterattacks, or uncovering player performance patterns, we'll walk through a reference architecture for developing, deploying, and operating AI applications and agents on Azure. 

Attendees will leave with practical guidance and ideas they can extend into their hackathon projects.

📌 This event is part of a series. Learn more here: https://aka.ms/PremierLeagueHack
